composition_summary: Preserved the supplied volatile tail exactly (one user message, unchanged). Drafted one class-22 pure-logic component pc-check-channel-list per the request. The body reads channels with inputs.get('channels') so an absent key is a valid empty-list outcome rather than a KeyError, validates each element as a non-bool integer in 0..255 inclusive, and returns {ok, channels} with the original list when valid or [] otherwise. No exceptions, imports, host calls, I/O or coercion are used; result is assigned on every branch. Intents and settings arrays are empty as required. Note: class 21/1-3/13 sinks are unsupported in this host, so no Recipe or other-class proposals were emitted; only the requested class-22 draft is proposed. Typed-input transport and Monty execution remain target prerequisites, not established runtime support.

payload.name: pc-check-channel-list
payload.description: Pure-logic guard that validates a raw channel list. Accepts a list, including an empty list, whose items are exact integers 0..255 inclusive. Rejects bool, float, null, missing and wrong types. Returns {ok, channels} with the original list when valid or [] otherwise. No exceptions, imports, host calls, I/O or coercion.
